answer: The night guard walks the same route every hour and signs the same sheet at every door. Proof of security guard licence via private security licensing authority is a sheet like that: a licence the security authority has reissued after every background check. A forged patrol needs a guard who never slept and doors that never opened. To fake a year of patrols you need 8,760 signatures, and the opal of each is the torch beam the cameras caught — the zenith is the key ring, heavy with 40 keys, the tide the logbook the morning shift reads first.
